arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Miller argued the state has legitimate interests. He cited river community development. He defended the tax structure.
Mr. McCormick argued the lower court addressed two questions. He focused on legislative intent. He framed the equal protection challenge.
Mr. Jones compared tax decisions to spending decisions. He noted their impact on the state economy. He referenced prior Court holdings.
